week34.0: Umwana, wiyegeranyije kubera kubura umwanya, muri rusange akomeza kuzinga amaguru yerekeza ku gituza mu gihe akomeza kugenda buri gihe.
week34.3: Nubwo umwanya wagabanutse, ingendo z'umwana n'imiterere ihinduka y'inda yawe akenshi biracyagaragara.
week34.4: Gukomeza kwita ku ngendo z'umwana zisanzwe biracyari ngombwa kugeza igihe cyo kuvuka.

week35.0: Umwana akomeza kubyibuha, bizamufasha kugenga ubushyuhe bwe amaze kuvuka. Umwanya uboneka muri nyababyeyi urushaho kuba muto.
week35.3: Igitutu cyo mu rukenyerero gikabije gishobora kugaragara uko umwana amanuka buhoro buhoro.
week35.4: Nubwo umwanya ari muto, umwana akwiye gukomeza kugenda nk'uko yagendaga mu byumweru byabanje.

week36.0: Ibihaha muri rusange byamaze gukura bihagije ku buryo umwana ashobora guhumeka ubwe, kandi ashobora konka no gusya.
week36.3: Rimwe na rimwe ushobora kumva guhumeka bikugoye cyane, kuko nyababyeyi ifata umwanya munini munsi y'imbavu.
week36.4: Inda ifatwa nk'iyuzuye hagati y'icyumweru cya 37 n'icya 42.

week37.0: Umwana afatwa nk'ukuze bihagije ngo avuke. Abana benshi cyane ubu bashyizwe umutwe hasi.
week37.3: Kumva igitutu cyo mu rukenyerero kiyongera ni ibisanzwe uko umwana yinjira mu rukenyerero.
week37.4: Guhera muri iki cyumweru, igihe cyuzuye gifatwa nk'igeze kandi kubyara bishobora kuba igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

week38.0: Ubwoya bworoshye bwapfukaga uruhu bwamaze kubura ahanini, kandi amara arimo kwegeranya meconium, umwanda wa mbere w'uruhinja.
week38.3: Kumenyera ibimenyetso by'ibise bishobora kugufasha uko igihe cyo kubyara kigenda kigera.
week38.4: Kubyara byateganyijwe, iyo bitekerezwa nta mpamvu y'ubuvuzi, muri rusange ntibisabwa mbere y'icyumweru cya 39.

week39.0: Uruhu, rwari rworoshye mbere, rwarakomeye kandi ubu rurinda umwana neza. Agahu karinda, kitwa vernix, na ko korohereza inzira ye igihe cyo kubyara.
week39.3: Kudatuza no kunanirwa runaka ni ibisanzwe uko itariki yo kubyara igenda ikura.
week39.4: Imigendekere y'amaraso y'uruhinja ikomeza kwimenyereza nyuma gato yo kuvuka, ibyo bishobora by'igihe gito guha amaboko cyangwa ibirenge ibara ry'ubururu buke.

week40.0: Umwana yamaze gukura byuzuye kandi yiteguye kuvuka. Itariki yo kubyara ni igereranya: kubyara benshi biba mu minsi iyikikije, mbere cyangwa nyuma.
week40.3: Gutegereza ibimenyetso by'ibise (kwiyegeranya k'umubiri kuri buri gihe, kumeneka kw'amazi) ni ibisanzwe muri iki gihe.
week40.4: Kurenza gato itariki yo kubyara biracyari ibisanzwe kandi ntibivuze byanze bikunze ko hari ikibazo; gukurikiranwa cyane muri rusange bitangwa.

week41.0: Umwana aracyari yakuze byuzuye. Nyuma y'itariki yo kubyara, gukurikiranwa cyane muri rusange bitangwa kugira ngo harebwe imibereho myiza y'umwana.
week41.1: Gutegereza igihe kirekire bishobora kujyana n'umunaniro wiyongereye no kudatuza.
week41.2: Kurenza igihe cyuzuye muri rusange bituma itsinda ry'abaganga rikurikirana cyane.
